intro.zh: 你在夜市租了一个摊位，只租五个晚上。卖烤饭团。
intro.en: You rented a night-market stall for five nights. You sell grilled rice balls.

text.zh: 隔壁卖章鱼烧的大叔看你半天搭不好棚子。
text.en: The takoyaki guy next door watches you fail to put up the awning.

result.zh: 他三下搭好，还送你一句「别放太多酱油」。
result.en: Done in a minute, plus a tip: "go easy on the soy sauce".

text.zh: 摊前突然排起了队。库存还剩 {stat:stock} 个。
text.en: Suddenly there's a queue. {stat:stock} left in stock.

result.zh: 后面几个人等不及走了。
result.en: A few people at the back give up.
Someone says they'll come back tomorrow.

text.zh: 九点开始下雨，人一下子少了。摆在外面的两个饭团被淋湿了。
text.en: It starts raining at nine. The crowd thins out, and two rice balls on the counter get soaked.

result.en: You go home and take a bath.

result.zh: 躲雨的人顺手买了几个。
result.en: People sheltering from the rain buy a few.

result.zh: 一个客人都没有，鞋湿透了。
result.en: Not one customer, and your shoes are soaked.

text.zh: 一个举着手机的人问能不能拍你烤饭团。
text.en: Someone with a phone asks if they can film you grilling.

result.zh: 第二天来了好几个说「看了视频」的人。
result.en: Next night, several people say they saw the video.

result.zh: 饭团掉地上了。视频很真实。
result.en: The rice ball hits the ground. Very authentic footage.

result.zh: 对方去拍隔壁章鱼烧了。
result.en: They go film the takoyaki instead.

text.zh: 章鱼烧大叔递来一小罐自家调的酱。
text.en: The takoyaki guy hands you a small jar of his own sauce.

result.en: The smell carries half a street.

result.zh: 他说「还行」，其实吃了两个。
result.en: He says "not bad" and eats two.

text.zh: 只剩 {stat:stock} 个的量了。超市还开着。
text.en: Only enough for {stat:stock} more. The supermarket is still open.

result.en: You haul back two bags of rice.

text.zh: 九点半，人流断了一会儿。
text.en: 9:30. The crowd drops off for a while.

result.en: Half a bottle of barley tea.
You hand out a few flyers on the way.

text.zh: 最后两晚摊位空着。下次找个帮手。
text.en: The stall sits empty for the last nights. Next time, bring a helper.

text.zh: 管理处问你下个月还来不来，摊位费打八折。
text.en: The organizers ask you back next month, with a discount on the stall fee.
You count it three times. {stat:money}, for real.

text.zh: 你和章鱼烧大叔商量明年合租一个大摊位。
text.en: You and the takoyaki guy plan to share a big stall next year.

text.zh: 钱没赚多少，但你知道怎么搭棚子了。
text.en: Not much money, but you can put up an awning now.
